system.description:
You know what a burial ground looks like when everything is where it should be.

Prerequisites Perception 1 rank

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Search checks made to notice disturbed graves, opened crypts, damaged funerary seals, concealed entrances within burial structures or physical evidence that a corpse has been moved.

When rolling Initiative within a cemetery, crypt, tomb or similar burial site, you gain a +10 circumstance bonus if an Undead creature, Unliving creature or grave-related hazard is involved in the encounter.

Both bonuses are offered in the roll dialog with the book's wording — tick when the scene matches.

conditionals.label: Grave Vigil
conditionals.scope: Search checks to notice disturbed graves, opened crypts, damaged funerary seals, concealed entrances in burial structures or evidence a corpse was moved

conditionals.label: Grave Vigil
conditionals.scope: Initiative in a cemetery, crypt, tomb or similar burial site when an Undead or Unliving creature or a grave-related hazard is involved
